title: Exclude all joint helper-relation subspaces in each current BIT boundary group
body:
No joint subspace of helper relations within one cocharted group can improve the fixed PR7001 BIT signed moment for `0<=kappa<=1/100`, in either orientation. This extends [PR #7720](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7720) from one relation to **every codimension up to 410**, while granting free causal receiver banks and scalar XOR work. Every lost productive target is charged. **No new kappa is claimed.**

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8a70046cafae35d29627017983d55cec71e06e27/research/bit-joint-relation-bank-obstruction/PROOF.md), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8a70046cafae35d29627017983d55cec71e06e27/research/bit-joint-relation-bank-obstruction/RESULT.json), [certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8a70046cafae35d29627017983d55cec71e06e27/research/bit-joint-relation-bank-obstruction/CERTIFICATE.json.gz), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8a70046cafae35d29627017983d55cec71e06e27/research/bit-joint-relation-bank-obstruction/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8a70046cafae35d29627017983d55cec71e06e27/research/bit-joint-relation-bank-obstruction/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8a70046cafae35d29627017983d55cec71e06e27/research/bit-joint-relation-bank-obstruction/CREDITS.md). The [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19714523) records the changed premise and family decision.

The certificate has **874 coordinate charges covering 385 nonterminal receiver spaces** across all 18 group-orientation cases. For any relation space U, the common-pivot inclusion `P(U intersect L) subset P(U) intersect P(L)` bounds every receiver rank loss at once. Transposed terminal flags also identify the exact paid rank attached to each pivot of U.

| Cases | Complete bound |
| --- | --- |
| 17 group-orientations | Each pivot either cancels one equal-rank terminal target or has integer charge strictly below its target rank. |
| Transposed 410-helper group | At most `7k+1<=15k/2` paid rank for `k>=2`, strictly below `k*8^(99/100)`; the retained certificate covers `k=1`. |

A small abstract receiver example has losing single lines but a profitable joint subspace. Its charges fail the new certificate gate. This demonstrates why a single-direction census alone could not establish the joint result.

The unchanged complete caller has 36 native invocations, 107352 paid calls, 19950 productive targets and rank surplus 1506. Fixed query, idle and root terms cancel. The local signed difference is multiplied by 36, so the joint contract cannot improve that complete bill. The selected saving `.00363005817` is unchanged; no historical caller ceiling is applied.

Base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The complete [PR7720 source proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3e56de8c160f259612f9766e06bf6990c7b5a3ef/research/bit-single-relation-bank-obstruction/PROOF.md), checker and inputs are retained unchanged at head `3e56de8c160f259612f9766e06bf6990c7b5a3ef`. The original native comes from [PR #7001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7001), with SHA-256 `51203e7fc75ba10bd3ac3f8e675759f47e13d262bea66b6600d1e515095cad78`. All 19 retained source/license files have exact Git blob and SHA-256 pins.

The [older G20 joint-capture proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b7c27a263b9e57d4e04b5e2dcb7b3199cc8c4170/research/bit-g20-entry-capture-capacity/PROOF.md) in [PR #5604](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5604) covers zero captures on another word. This proof covers reconstruction from retained banks without requiring a paid row to become zero. The older R439 common-first-contact classification in [PR #1253](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1253) also has a different boundary. Neither is claimed as new work here.

Use CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-joint-relation-bank-obstruction
```

Each command prints the retained baseline result, then:

```text
PASS_JOINT_BIT_RELATION_OBSTRUCTION 18 874 385
```

Normal and optimized replay pass. A separate greedy column-rank check verifies all new pivot sets, receiver coordinate transforms and chronological terminal witnesses. Six new mutations fail; the retained source package reruns its six original controls, both native interpretations, exact frame checks and complete invoice. Source bytes, committed bytes/modes, source history, package export, sealed read-only Git-free replay, public links and rendered publication readback pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44365632156/job/135018462231) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

The result keeps paid forms, order and frames fixed. New routes, changed forms, matrix-valued receiver coefficients, simultaneous relations across distinct boundary groups and compositions across orientations remain open. The physical caller, native phases, owned storage, compiler, tape and analytic interfaces remain inherited, with all five framework assumptions. Full predecessor suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Both new checking paths have one author after source inspection; this is not blind, independent human or formal acceptance. No selected-frontier or other workstream change is included.
